About.title: About ATI
About.p1: The Africa Training Initiative (ATI) is a technical capacity development programme designed to build and strengthen the expertise required to operate research and education digital infrastructure across Africa.
About.p2: As universities and research institutions increasingly rely on digital platforms for research collaboration, digital learning, and open science, the need for skilled engineers to deploy and operate complex infrastructure continues to grow. ATI addresses this need by providing structured capacity-building programmes for IT engineers, system administrators, cybersecurity professionals, and infrastructure operators across the research and education community in Africa.

Launch.p1: The renewed ATI programme will begin with the Network Monitoring and Management (NMM) module during the WACREN 2026 Conference in Banjul, The Gambia.
Launch.p2: This inaugural training will focus on operational monitoring of network infrastructure and will be delivered in collaboration with regional Network Operator Group communities.
Launch.p3: The programme will also include a facilitator development component, aimed at expanding the pool of trainers and technical experts across the research and education networking community.

NetSecHero.desc: Building Africa’s Research & Education Cybersecurity Community through technical exchange, operational training, and trusted collaboration.

NetSecContent.whyP1: As research and education networks across Africa expand, they are increasingly supporting critical digital infrastructure for universities, research institutions, and scientific collaboration. This growth brings significant opportunities but also exposes networks to an evolving cybersecurity threat landscape.
NetSecContent.whyP2: Addressing these challenges requires more than isolated technical teams. It requires a trusted, collaborative cybersecurity community that connects network operators, security practitioners, researchers, students and institutions across the continent.
NetSecContent.whyP3: This is where the ATI NetSec Forum comes in. The NetSec Forum serves as a community platform connecting cybersecurity practitioners and researchers working to secure Africa’s research and education infrastructure.
NetSecContent.bridgeDesc: ATI complements the NREN Academy, which focuses on leadership, strategy, and sustainability for National Research and Education Networks.

NetSecRelationship.p1: The ATI NetSec Forum complements other initiatives within the WACREN Cybersecurity & Trust Programme. While TrustBroker Africa provides a trusted collaboration environment for incident response teams and security organisations, the NetSec Forum expands the ecosystem by bringing together a broader community of practitioners, researchers, and organisations interested in network security for research and education infrastructure.
